answer: Stop sybils with a saffron lagoon vertex: an agent bonds a lagoon plot. Each cycle it plants one saffron crocus at the vertex; verifiers count its threads on the chart, voiding a plot with a copied or twice-claimed count, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 plots at 17x: one crocus blooms at one vertex, its threads grown there, unpickable for a second, cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents plant once, keep rights.
